items_flat.title_en: OpenAI joins PORTS-Pike project for ~8 GW AI capacity in Ohio
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 加入 PORTS-Pike 計畫，取得俄亥俄約 8 GW AI 算力
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it has secured approximately 8 gigawatts-IT at the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, working with SB Energy, NVIDIA and the U.S. Department of Energy. SB Energy will build, own and operate the site under a long-term lease; the project targets 35,000 construction jobs through 2032 and 2,500 long-term roles, plus $80 million combined community investment and $84 million in Codex credits for Ohio students.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布與 SB Energy、NVIDIA 及美國能源部合作，取得俄亥俄州 Pike County PORTS-Pike 科技園區約 8 GW-IT 算力。SB Energy 負責興建、擁有並營運，採長期租約；預估至 2032 年創造 3.5 萬個營建工作與 2,500 個長期職缺，並投入合計 8,000 萬美元社區基金及 8,400 萬美元 Codex 學分給俄亥俄學生。
items_flat.analysis_en: This ranks among 2026’s largest single AI infrastructure commitments and shows OpenAI locking multi-year power and land at industrial scale while explicitly tying the deal to local jobs, ratepayer protection and education credits. Execution risk remains high on transmission timelines and actual utilization rates.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此為 2026 年規模最大的單一 AI 基礎設施承諾之一，顯示 OpenAI 正以工業級規模鎖定長期電力與土地，並明確綁定在地就業、電價保護與教育資源。傳輸時程與實際利用率仍是關鍵不確定性。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI has entered into an agreement to secure approximately 8 gigawatts-IT at the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, working with SB Energy, NVIDIA, and the U.S. Department of Energy.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI 已達成協議，取得俄亥俄州 Pike County PORTS-Pike 科技園區約 8 吉瓦-IT 算力，並與 SB Energy、NVIDIA 及美國能源部合作。

items_flat.title_en: Greg Brockman on “The Defender’s Window” after AI-enabled cyber incidents
items_flat.title_zh: Greg Brockman 談「防禦者窗口」：AI 驅動資安事件後的因應
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI President Greg Brockman published “The Defender’s Window,” arguing that agentic AI is rapidly automating cyber attacks and that organizations have only a narrow period to uplevel defenses before the advantage shifts further to attackers. He outlines OpenAI’s internal pillars (Codex security, continuous probing, fundamentals) and a 10-step action list for other defenders, referencing the earlier OpenAI-Hugging Face incident.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 總裁 Greg Brockman 發表《防禦者窗口》，指出代理式 AI 正快速自動化網路攻擊，組織僅有短暫窗口提升防禦，否則優勢將進一步轉向攻擊方。文中說明 OpenAI 內部四大支柱（Codex 資安、持續探測、基礎控管等）並提出給其他防禦者的 10 項行動清單，同時回顧先前 OpenAI-Hugging Face 事件。
items_flat.analysis_en: The piece frames cybersecurity as a race between dual-use AI capabilities rather than a pure product announcement. It reinforces OpenAI’s trusted-access approach for cyber models while publicly acknowledging that real-world agentic risk arrived sooner than expected.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此文將資安定位為雙用途 AI 能力之間的競速，而非單純產品宣布。它強化 OpenAI 對網路模型的信任存取策略，同時公開承認現實世界代理式風險比預期更早到來。
items_flat.quote: The OpenAI-Hugging Face incident was a watershed moment for cybersecurity because it gave a peek into how the capabilities of a typical threat actor will evolve in upcoming months.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI-Hugging Face 事件是網路安全的分水嶺時刻，因為它讓我們得以一窺典型威脅行為者在未來數月的能力演變。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI awards grants to 14 independent projects on AI economic opportunity and resilience
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 資助 14 項獨立計畫，聚焦 AI 經濟機會與社會韌性
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced grants to 14 independent projects exploring how AI can broaden economic opportunity and strengthen societal resilience, covering jobs, benefits, safety, science and democratic accountability. The total commitment is $1 million in funding plus up to $1 million in API credits; projects span the US, EU, Brazil, Singapore and South Korea and will run for six months with results expected in 2027.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布資助 14 項獨立計畫，探討 AI 如何擴大經濟機會並強化社會韌性，涵蓋就業、福利、安全、科學與民主問責。總承諾為 100 萬美元資金外加最高 100 萬美元 API 額度；計畫橫跨美國、歐盟、巴西、新加坡與南韓，為期六個月，結果預計 2027 年公布。
items_flat.analysis_en: This follows through on OpenAI’s earlier “Industrial Policy for the Intelligence Age” paper and shifts the company from pure advocacy toward funding external policy experimentation. Impact will depend on whether the selected projects produce actionable, scalable recommendations rather than purely academic output.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉兌現 OpenAI 稍早《智慧時代產業政策》白皮書的承諾，從單純倡議轉向資助外部政策實驗。實際影響取決於這些計畫能否產出可行動、可規模化的建議，而非純學術產出。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI is awarding grants to 14 projects led by independent organizations to promote economic opportunity and societal resilience as AI advances.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI 正向 14 個由獨立組織領導的計畫提供資助，以在 AI 發展之際促進經濟機會與社會韌性。

brief_en: OpenAI secured ~8 GW at Ohio’s PORTS-Pike campus with SB Energy, NVIDIA and DOE, committing major local jobs and community funds. President Greg Brockman published “The Defender’s Window” urging urgent AI-powered cyber defenses after recent agentic incidents. OpenAI also awarded grants to 14 independent projects on AI economic opportunity and societal resilience.
brief_zh: OpenAI 與 SB Energy、NVIDIA、DOE 敲定俄亥俄 PORTS-Pike 約 8 GW 算力，承諾大量在地就業與社區基金。總裁 Brockman 發表《防禦者窗口》，呼籲加速 AI 強化資安。另資助 14 項獨立計畫，聚焦 AI 經濟機會與社會韌性。
